simple.meaning: מִשְׁתֶּה (mishteh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “drink , by implication, drinking (the act); also (by implication) a banquet or (generally) feast.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 46 times across Genesis, Judges, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 19:3. Its contexts include family, family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִשְׁתֶּה (H4960).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מִשְׁתֶּה (mishteh) / H4960 is traced through Genesis 19:3, Genesis 21:8, Genesis 26:30, Genesis 29:22 as a generated source-based concept entry.
